title: The 24 Solar Terms: Autumn Equinox
synopsis: Learn about several different Chinese customs regarding the autumn equinox.

fullText.simplified:
二十四节气之立秋

    立秋，是二十四节气中的第13个节气，更是秋天的第一个节气。“立秋”表示秋天开始之意。立秋以后，每下一次雨就凉快一次，因而有“一场秋雨一场寒”的说法。
    秋天是丰收的季节，以农为本的中国人自古就很看重这个节气。相传宋朝时，每到立秋这一天，宫里的人就会把种在花盆里的树搬到里面，等到立秋的时间一到，太史官便高声喊道：“秋来了！”话音一落，树上便会落下几片叶子，预示着秋天的到来。
    在中国各地，立秋当天有着各种各样的传统习俗。民间流行在立秋这天称体重，并和夏天的体重做对比，如果瘦了就要吃点儿好的进补，而补的办法就是“贴秋膘”。这种习俗在北京、河北一带十分流行。到立秋时，人们会吃炖肉、肉饺子、红烧鱼等。
    在天津、江浙等地有“咬秋”的习俗，这一天人们要围坐在一起吃瓜果。这种行为在天津象征着夏日漫漫，炎热难熬，时至立秋，将其咬住；在江苏是为了不生痱子；而在浙江是为了防传染病。
    在江南一带还有立秋日吃秋桃的习俗。每到立秋当天大人孩子都要吃秋桃。我们平时吃完桃子会直接扔掉桃核，而在立秋这天，大人们会把吃剩的桃核收集起来，一直保存到半年以后的除夕夜。然后在除夕夜那天，人们会把保存的立秋日桃核扔进火中，把它烧成灰，表示带走一年的坏运气。
    中国人的立秋习俗，不仅仅是为了纪念这一节气，更是对美好生活的向往！
fullText.traditional:
二十四節氣之立秋

    立秋，是二十四節氣中的第13個節氣，更是秋天的第一個節氣。“立秋”表示秋天開始之意。立秋以後，每下一次雨就涼快一次，因而有“一場秋雨一場寒”的說法。
    秋天是豐收的季節，以農為本的中國人自古就很看重這個節氣。相傳宋朝時，每到立秋這一天，宮裡的人就會把種在花盆裡的樹搬到裡面，等到立秋的時間一到，太史官便高聲喊道：“秋來了！”話音一落，樹上便會落下幾片葉子，預示著秋天的到來。
    在中國各地，立秋當天有著各種各樣的傳統習俗。民間流行在立秋這天稱體重，並和夏天的體重做對比，如果瘦了就要吃點兒好的進補，而補的辦法就是“貼秋膘”。這種習俗在北京、河北一帶十分流行。到立秋時，人們會吃燉肉、肉餃子、紅燒魚等。
    在天津、江浙等地有“咬秋”的習俗，這一天人們要圍坐在一起吃瓜果。這種行為在天津象徵著夏日漫漫，炎熱難熬，時至立秋，將其咬住；在江蘇是為了不生痱子；而在浙江是為了防傳染病。
    在江南一帶還有立秋日吃秋桃的習俗。每到立秋當天大人孩子都要吃秋桃。我們平時吃完桃子會直接扔掉桃核，而在立秋這天，大人們會把吃剩的桃核收集起來，一直保存到半年以後的除夕夜。然後在除夕夜那天，人們會把保存的立秋日桃核扔進火中，把它燒成灰，表示帶走一年的壞運氣。
    中國人的立秋習俗，不僅僅是為了紀念這一節氣，更是對美好生活的嚮往！

sentences.english: The 24 Solar Terms: Autumn Equinox

sentences.simplified: 立秋，是二十四节气中的第13个节气，更是秋天的第一个节气。
sentences.traditional: 立秋，是二十四節氣中的第13個節氣，更是秋天的第一個節氣。

sentences.simplified: “立秋”表示秋天开始之意。
sentences.traditional: “立秋”表示秋天開始之意。
sentences.pinyin: lì qiū biǎo shì qiū tiān kāi shǐ zhī yì
sentences.english: The autumn equinox is the thirteenth out of twenty-four solar terms, and the first solar term in autumn.

sentences.simplified: 立秋以后，每下一次雨就凉快一次，
sentences.traditional: 立秋以後，每下一次雨就涼快一次，
sentences.pinyin: lì qiū yǐ hòu měi xià yí cì yǔ jiù liáng kuai yí cì
sentences.english: “Autumn Equinox” denotes the meaning of the beginning of autumn.

sentences.simplified: 因而有“一场秋雨一场寒”的说法。
sentences.traditional: 因而有“一場秋雨一場寒”的說法。
sentences.pinyin: yīn ér yǒu yì cháng qiū yǔ yì cháng hán de shuō fǎ
sentences.english: After the autumn equinox, every time it rains it cools down some more.
Because of this, there came the saying “A spell of autumn rain, a spell of cold”.

sentences.simplified: 秋天是丰收的季节，
sentences.traditional: 秋天是豐收的季節，
sentences.pinyin: qiū tiān shì fēng shōu de jì jié

sentences.simplified: 以农为本的中国人自古就很看重这个节气。
sentences.traditional: 以農為本的中國人自古就很看重這個節氣。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ nóng wéi běn de zhōng guó rén zì gǔ jiù hěn kàn zhòng zhè ge jié qi
sentences.english: Autumn is a season of harvest.

sentences.simplified: 相传宋朝时，每到立秋这一天，
sentences.traditional: 相傳宋朝時，每到立秋這一天，
sentences.pinyin: xiāng chuán sòng cháo shí měi dào lì qiū zhè yì tiān
sentences.english: So, the agriculture-oriented Chinese people have placed great importance on this solar term since ancient times.

sentences.simplified: 宫里的人就会把种在花盆里的树搬到里面，
sentences.traditional: 宮裡的人就會把種在花盆裡的樹搬到裡面，
sentences.pinyin: gōng lǐ de rén jiù huì bǎ zhòng zài huā pén lǐ de shù bān dào lǐ miàn
sentences.english: According to legend, during the Song dynasty, every year on the day of the autumn equinox, ..

sentences.simplified: 等到立秋的时间一到，太史官便高声喊道：“秋来了！”
sentences.traditional: 等到立秋的時間一到，太史官便高聲喊道：“秋來了！”
sentences.pinyin: děng dào lì qiū de shí jiān yí dào tài shǐ guān biàn gāo shēng hǎn dào qiū lái le
sentences.english: .. the people in the imperial palace would bring in trees planted in pots.

sentences.simplified: 话音一落，树上便会落下几片叶子，预示着秋天的到来。
sentences.traditional: 話音一落，樹上便會落下幾片葉子，預示著秋天的到來。
sentences.pinyin: huà yīn yí luò shù shang biàn huì luò xià jǐ piàn yè zi yù shì zhe qiū tiān de dào lái
sentences.english: And once the autumn equinox arrived, the court astronomer would shout loudly, “Autumn is here!”
As soon as the sound of his voice fell, several leaves would fall from the trees, foretelling the arrival of autumn.

sentences.simplified: 在中国各地，立秋当天有着各种各样的传统习俗。
sentences.traditional: 在中國各地，立秋當天有著各種各樣的傳統習俗。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó gè dì lì qiū dāng tiān yǒu zhe gè zhǒng gè yàng de chuán tǒng xí sú

sentences.simplified: 民间流行在立秋这天称体重，
sentences.traditional: 民間流行在立秋這天稱體重，
sentences.pinyin: mín jiān liú xíng zài lì qiū zhè tiān chēng tǐ zhòng
sentences.english: In different places across China, the day of the autumn equinox comes with all sorts of traditions.

sentences.simplified: 并和夏天的体重做对比，
sentences.traditional: 並和夏天的體重做對比，
sentences.pinyin: bìng hé xià tiān de tǐ zhòng zuò duì bǐ
sentences.english: Among the people it is popular to weigh oneself on the day of the autumn equinox, ..

sentences.simplified: 如果瘦了就要吃点儿好的进补，而补的办法就是“贴秋膘”。
sentences.traditional: 如果瘦了就要吃點兒好的進補，而補的辦法就是“貼秋膘”。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ shòu le jiù yào chī diǎn'r hǎo de jìn bǔ ér bǔ de bàn fǎ jiù shì tiē qiū biāo
sentences.english: .. and compare this weight to one’s weight in the summer.

sentences.simplified: 这种习俗在北京、河北一带十分流行。
sentences.traditional: 這種習俗在北京、河北一帶十分流行。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng xí sú zài běi jīng hé běi yí dài shí fēn liú xíng
sentences.english: If you have lost weight, then you should get some good nourishment. This nourishment comes from ”getting autumn fat”.

sentences.simplified: 到立秋时，人们会吃炖肉、肉饺子、红烧鱼等。
sentences.traditional: 到立秋時，人們會吃燉肉、肉餃子、紅燒魚等。
sentences.pinyin: dào lì qiū shí rén men huì chī dùn ròu ròu jiǎo zi hóng shāo yú děng
sentences.english: This type of custom is very popular in the Beijing and Hebei region.
When the autumn equinox comes, people will eat meat stew, meat dumplings, braised fish, an so on.

sentences.simplified: 在天津、江浙等地有“咬秋”的习俗，
sentences.traditional: 在天津、江浙等地有“咬秋”的習俗，
sentences.pinyin: zài tiān jīn jiāng zhè děng dì yǒu yǎo qiū de xí sú

sentences.simplified: 这一天人们要围坐在一起吃瓜果。
sentences.traditional: 這一天人們要圍坐在一起吃瓜果。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì tiān rén men yào wéi zuò zài yì qǐ chī guā guǒ
sentences.english: In places such as Tianjin, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang there is a custom called “eating the autumn”.

sentences.simplified: 这种行为在天津象征着夏日漫漫，炎热难熬，
sentences.traditional: 這種行為在天津象徵著夏日漫漫，炎熱難熬，
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng xíng wéi zài tiān jīn xiàng zhēng zhe xià rì màn màn yán rè nán áo
sentences.english: On this day, people will sit in a circle together and eat melons and fruits.

sentences.simplified: 时至立秋，将其咬住；
sentences.traditional: 時至立秋，將其咬住；
sentences.pinyin: shí zhì lì qiū jiāng qí yǎo zhù
sentences.english: In Tianjin, this activity symbolizes that after a long and hot summer, ..

sentences.simplified: 在江苏是为了不生痱子；而在浙江是为了防传染病。
sentences.traditional: 在江蘇是為了不生痱子；而在浙江是為了防傳染病。
sentences.pinyin: zài jiāng sū shì wèi le bù shēng fèi zi ér zài zhè jiāng shì wèi le fáng chuán rǎn bìng
sentences.english: .. the autumn equinox has arrived and should be grasped firmly.
In Jiangsu this activity is to prevent heat rash, and in Zhejiang it’s to prevent the spread of disease.

sentences.simplified: 在江南一带还有立秋日吃秋桃的习俗。
sentences.traditional: 在江南一帶還有立秋日吃秋桃的習俗。
sentences.pinyin: zài jiāng nán yí dài hái yǒu lì qiū rì chī qiū táo de xí sú

sentences.simplified: 每到立秋当天大人孩子都要吃秋桃。
sentences.traditional: 每到立秋當天大人孩子都要吃秋桃。
sentences.pinyin: měi dào lì qiū dāng tiān dà ren hái zi dōu yào chī qiū táo
sentences.english: In the Jiangnan region, there is also the custom of eating autumn peaches during the autumn equinox.

sentences.simplified: 我们平时吃完桃子会直接扔掉桃核，
sentences.traditional: 我們平時吃完桃子會直接扔掉桃核，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men píng shí chī wán táo zi huì zhí jiē rēng diào táo hé
sentences.english: Every year on the day of the autumn equinox, both adults and children will eat peaches.

sentences.simplified: 而在立秋这天，大人们会把吃剩的桃核收集起来，
sentences.traditional: 而在立秋這天，大人們會把吃剩的桃核收集起來，
sentences.pinyin: ér zài lì qiū zhè tiān dà ren men huì bǎ chī shèng de táo hé shōu jí qǐ lái
sentences.english: Normally, after we finish a peach we just throw away the pit, ..

sentences.simplified: 一直保存到半年以后的除夕夜。
sentences.traditional: 一直保存到半年以後的除夕夜。
sentences.pinyin: yì zhí bǎo cún dào bàn nián yǐ hòu de chú xī yè
sentences.english: .. but on the autumn equinox, people will save the leftover peach pit.

sentences.simplified: 然后在除夕夜那天，人们会把保存的立秋日桃核扔进火中，把它烧成灰，
sentences.traditional: 然後在除夕夜那天，人們會把保存的立秋日桃核扔進火中，把它燒成灰，
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu zài chú xī yè nà tiān rén men huì bǎ bǎo cún de lì qiū rì táo hé rēng jìn huǒ zhōng bǎ tā shāo chéng huī
sentences.english: They’ll keep it until the eve of the Chinese New Year, half a year away.

sentences.simplified: 表示带走一年的坏运气。
sentences.traditional: 表示帶走一年的壞運氣。
sentences.pinyin: biǎo shì dài zǒu yì nián de huài yùn qi
sentences.english: Then, on the eve of Chinese New Year, people will throw the saved peach pit into fire, and let it burn into ash.
This represents the removal of an entire year’s bad luck and misfortune.

sentences.simplified: 中国人的立秋习俗，不仅仅是为了纪念这一节气，
sentences.traditional: 中國人的立秋習俗，不僅僅是為了紀念這一節氣，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén de lì qiū xí sú bù jǐn jǐn shì wèi le jì niàn zhè yì jié qi

sentences.simplified: 更是对美好生活的向往！
sentences.traditional: 更是對美好生活的嚮往！
sentences.pinyin: gèng shì duì měi hǎo shēng huó de xiàng wǎng
sentences.english: The Chinese people’s autumn equinox customs are not just a celebration of a solar term.
They are even more about a yearning for a good life!

raw.synopsis: Learn about several different Chinese customs regarding the autumn equinox.
sentence_translations: The 24 Solar Terms: Autumn Equinox
The autumn equinox is the thirteenth out of twenty-four solar terms, and the first solar term in autumn.
“Autumn Equinox” denotes the meaning of the beginning of autumn.
After the autumn equinox, every time it rains it cools down some more.
Because of this, there came the saying “A spell of autumn rain, a spell of cold”.
Autumn is a season of harvest.
So, the agriculture-oriented Chinese people have placed great importance on this solar term since ancient times.
According to legend, during the Song dynasty, every year on the day of the autumn equinox, ..
.. the people in the imperial palace would bring in trees planted in pots.
And once the autumn equinox arrived, the court astronomer would shout loudly, “Autumn is here!”
As soon as the sound of his voice fell, several leaves would fall from the trees, foretelling the arrival of autumn.
In different places across China, the day of the autumn equinox comes with all sorts of traditions.
Among the people it is popular to weigh oneself on the day of the autumn equinox, ..
.. and compare this weight to one’s weight in the summer.
If you have lost weight, then you should get some good nourishment. This nourishment comes from ”getting autumn fat”.
This type of custom is very popular in the Beijing and Hebei region.
When the autumn equinox comes, people will eat meat stew, meat dumplings, braised fish, an so on.
In places such as Tianjin, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang there is a custom called “eating the autumn”.
On this day, people will sit in a circle together and eat melons and fruits.
In Tianjin, this activity symbolizes that after a long and hot summer, ..
.. the autumn equinox has arrived and should be grasped firmly.
In Jiangsu this activity is to prevent heat rash, and in Zhejiang it’s to prevent the spread of disease.
In the Jiangnan region, there is also the custom of eating autumn peaches during the autumn equinox.
Every year on the day of the autumn equinox, both adults and children will eat peaches.
Normally, after we finish a peach we just throw away the pit, ..
.. but on the autumn equinox, people will save the leftover peach pit.
They’ll keep it until the eve of the Chinese New Year, half a year away.
Then, on the eve of Chinese New Year, people will throw the saved peach pit into fire, and let it burn into ash.
This represents the removal of an entire year’s bad luck and misfortune.
The Chinese people’s autumn equinox customs are not just a celebration of a solar term.
They are even more about a yearning for a good life!
